preconditions.description: N is an integer and S is a string.
The length of S is equal to N.

postconditions.description: The return value is either a substring of S or '-1'.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or (S.count(return_value) >= 2 and all(S[i:i+len(return_value)] != S[i+len(return_value):i+2*len(return_value)] for i in range(len(S) - len(return_value) + 1)))
postconditions.description: If the return value is not '-1', it is a substring of S that appears at least twice and does not overlap with itself.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or all(len(sub) <= len(return_value) for sub in {S[i:j] for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i+1, len(S)+1) if S.count(S[i:j]) >= 2 and all(S[x:x+len(S[i:j])] != S[x+len(S[i:j]):x+2*len(S[i:j])] for x in range(len(S) - len(S[i:j]) + 1))})
postconditions.description: If the return value is not '-1', it is the longest substring of S that appears at least twice and does not overlap with itself.
